description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). One event identity (block 0x09 repeated, index 0) is read on two pages that both cover blocks 100 to 199: a finalized release naming a1 at block 150, and a finalized release naming b2 at block 250, outside its page's range. The out of range copy still counts for the copy agreement rule, so a1 and b2 are both unverified.
